# US Consumer Confidence Plunges to Lowest Level Since 2014

## Takeaways by Bloomberg AI

US consumer confidence fell in September to the lowest level since 2014 as views about the economy and the labor market deteriorated.

The Conference Board’s gauge of confidence decreased 6.7 points to 81.9 after a downward revision to the prior month, data released Tuesday showed. The figure was well below all expectations in a Bloomberg survey of economists.
results.title: US Consumer Confidence Falls to Lowest Since 2014 on Economic Concerns - Bloomberg

results.content: NEW YORK, Sept. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The Conference Board Consumer Confidence Index® fell by 6.7 points to 81.9 (1985=100) in September, down from 88.6 in August. The Present Situation Index—based on consumers' assessment of current business and labor market conditions—retreated by 7.9 points to 109.3. The Expectations Index—based on consumers' short-term outlook for income, business, and labor market conditions—fell by 5.9 points to 63.6, its third consecutive monthly decline.
